# AudioEnhancerMAX

> Free, open-source local audio editing for Apple Silicon Macs. Created by Fabrizio Degni. Canonical product website: https://www.fabriziodegni.com/AudioEnhancerMAX/

## Mac 4.1.5 BETA

Mac 4.1.5 build 4.1.9 is a Developer ID-signed and Apple-notarized direct download for Apple Silicon on macOS 13 or later. Studio includes a floating dock, quick tools, non-destructive multitrack editing and a playback meter.

- [Mac BETA notes](https://github.com/sev7enITA/AudioEnhancerMAX/releases/tag/v4.1.5-beta.1)
- [Mac DMG](https://github.com/sev7enITA/AudioEnhancerMAX/releases/download/v4.1.5-beta.1/AudioEnhancerMAX-v4.1.5-beta.1-build-4.1.9-macOS-arm64.dmg)
- [Dock screenshots](https://www.fabriziodegni.com/AudioEnhancerMAX/press.html#gallery-4-1-5)

Mac 4.1.2 build 4.1.4 refreshes the local workspace and speech tools. Android 4.1.2 build 19 is a signed APK. iOS 4.1.2 build 14 is an unsigned Xcode archive for developers. Verify Content adds local media and supported artwork metadata on the companion. Public C2PA samples use a test certificate.

## 4.1 BETA

Verify content brings offline C2PA, a SHA-256 fingerprint and bounded audio measurements into one workspace on Mac, iOS and Android. Mac 4.1.0 is a signed and notarized Apple Silicon download. Android build 16 is a signed BETA APK. iOS build 12 is an unsigned developer archive with source. Mobile store availability and physical phone testing are pending.

- [4.1 BETA releases and checksums](https://github.com/sev7enITA/AudioEnhancerMAX/releases/tag/v4.1.0-beta.1)

## Earlier Mac 4.0 BETA · build 4.0.5

Clean up audio. Compare the difference. Export with a report linked to the revision.

The direct 4.0 BETA targets Apple Silicon with macOS 13 or later. Developer ID signed, Apple notarized and stapled. The 3.9.0 direct stable and the App Store edition have separate records. Workspace steps are Import & clean, Listen & edit and Export. Features include same-excerpt spectral preview, playback-only level matching, speech cut timeline mapping, revision-bound processing reports and C2PA credentials with a configured signer. Verification samples use a test signer. Android APK build 14 is available for testing. iOS build 10 is in device testing and its source is public.

- [Mac 4.0 BETA download](https://www.fabriziodegni.com/AudioEnhancerMAX/download.html#beta-4-0-0)
- [GitHub release](https://github.com/sev7enITA/AudioEnhancerMAX/releases/tag/v4.0.0-beta.1)
- [C2PA verification samples](https://www.fabriziodegni.com/AudioEnhancerMAX/#c2pa-4-0-0)
- [Build verification record](https://github.com/sev7enITA/AudioEnhancerMAX/releases/download/v4.0.0-beta.1/RELEASE-VERIFICATION.json)
- [4.0 BETA press kit EN / IT](https://www.fabriziodegni.com/AudioEnhancerMAX/press.html)
## Product facts

Reviewed 2026-10-27. Direct release 3.9.0, build 3.9.2, targets Apple Silicon (arm64) and macOS 13 or later. Free download; MIT license. The direct DMG is Developer ID signed, Apple notarized and stapled. This does not establish Mac App Store approval.

Core DSP and local Whisper transcription run on the Mac. Models may download on first use. Optional Microsoft Edge Neural TTS sends submitted text to Microsoft; Ollama assistance is a separate local helper; Android workers are an optional experimental trusted-LAN boundary. Engine availability varies by installation. Personal Voice Studio is development work, not a promised feature of the stable DMG.

Supported workflows include speech cleanup, reviewed transcript-based cuts and mutes, non-destructive edit history, delivery profiles, processing reports and revision-bound Project Capsules. Loudness checks and provenance hashes do not certify audio quality, transcription accuracy, consent or compliance. Listen to the result before accepting it.

Music brief in stable 3.9.0 prepares editable structured text prompts from six presets, with separate lyrics and JSON export. It does not generate music. Optional local Ollama suggestions require permission and review. Drafts are session-only. Earlier Experimental 1 remains a separate preview installation.

## Earlier mobile companion 4.0 BETA

Android 4.0.0 build 14 is available as an APK for testing. iOS 4.0.0 build 10 is being tested and its source is public. Availability on Google Play, TestFlight and the iOS App Store is pending. Use the direct Mac 4.0 BETA for the local connection. Real-device and file-provider testing continues.

Studio includes trim, gain, Voice EQ, peak normalisation, A/B and separate WAV export. Import filters are saved and mismatched media is rejected before replacing the current recording. Both apps decode supported WAV, MP3, M4A/AAC and FLAC. Android offers Ogg/Opus and AMR, and iOS offers CAF/AIFF. The device and codec determine compatibility. Supported video can be exported to a new MP4 if the replacement audio retains the same frame count, rate and channels.

Discover the Mac from the phone, or make the phone discoverable for 90 seconds and send the invitation from the Mac. Compare the eight-digit code on both devices. QR pairing is also available. Transfer and optional foreground Voice EQ worker mode use the paired local connection. Video stays on the phone when only the audio is sent. Studio and Music brief use no cloud upload, account or analytics. About links to support and privacy and identifies the build.

- [Android 4.0 BETA APK](https://github.com/sev7enITA/AudioEnhancerMAX/releases/download/v4.0.0-beta.1/AudioEnhancerMAX-Companion-v4.0.0-build-14-Android-QA.apk)
- [iOS 4.0 source](https://github.com/sev7enITA/AudioEnhancerMAX/tree/v4.0.0-beta.1/ios-companion)
- [Earlier mobile preview and checksums](https://sourceforge.net/projects/audioenhancermax/files/mobile-preview-2026-11-06/)
- [English 3:30 overview](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y63FdPvqxVI), recorded 5 November on an earlier build.
